payload.test_method: One Num Lock-off alias was deliberately removed from the live compositor binding table. The running service detected the partial loss and restored the complete expected set automatically.
payload.expected_result: A partial loss of any expected dynamic binding is detected and the complete binding set is restored.
payload.actual_result: The deliberately removed alias returned automatically, all 45 expected binding combinations were present, and the compositor reported no configuration errors.
payload.limitations: This is one journal-imported live test on one system. It tested one deliberately removed alias and then complete table inspection, not every possible sequence of partial loss or compositor failure.
payload.provenance: Imported from the private journal with the exact public plugin revision linked; no raw compositor output is attached.
payload.adverse_effects: No adverse effect was recorded. The service continues periodic read-only binding checks and can re-register its own bindings.

activation.details: The updated plugin service remained active after the recovery test.

root_cause.rationale: The prior sentinel-only check could miss partial loss; complete expected-entry comparison detected and repaired the deliberately absent non-sentinel alias.
